deferred: The descriptive rank-frequency trend still excludes ranks 1-3 and frequency-one types. No statistical rationale for these exact exclusions was found in the implementation history or tests; no power-law adequacy test is implemented.

Observed-order vocabulary growth follows stable source-path order without permutations or rarefaction. Its exponent and R-squared describe this one nested accumulation path; uncertainty and order sensitivity are not estimated.

The former window-slot score is inactive in the score selector. Its legacy logDice field uses total window positions rather than ordinary node frequency. Overlapping windows can repeat token events; contingency-derived scores can become unavailable. A standard logDice option requires a separately specified event model and numerical validation.
